def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Improved polynomial model for log10(|ID|/A) with less parameters."""
    a0, a1, a2, gamma, delta = parameters
    gated_power = gate_voltage_abs * a1 + a2
    drained_power = drain_voltage_abs * (a1 + a2)
    
    return a0 + gamma * np.log(gated_power) + delta * np.log(drained_power)
